instructions.original_snippets: NEVER silence type errors with unchecked assertions
instructions.content: Never use an unchecked `as` assertion to silence a type error; narrow with a runtime check first so the guarantee is real, not asserted.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER leave a switch over a union without an exhaustiveness check
instructions.content: Never leave a switch over a discriminated union without a `never`-typed default branch, so adding a new variant without handling it is a compile error.

instructions.original_snippets: Making illegal states unrepresentable with discriminated unions
instructions.content: Model impossible field combinations out of existence with a discriminated union rather than checking for them at runtime.

instructions.original_snippets: Type predicate functions (is* functions) for object-shape validation
instructions.content: Write an `is*` type predicate function to validate an object's shape at runtime and narrow its type afterward.

instructions.original_snippets: Guard against undefined with an explicit conditional check before access
instructions.content: Add an explicit guard before accessing a possibly-undefined value instead of forcing access with a non-null assertion.

instructions.original_snippets: Choose default value vs throw per function based on whether absence is expected or an error
instructions.content: When guarding against undefined, return a sensible default when absence is a normal case, and throw a descriptive error when absence indicates a bug.
